## Frozen outcome and scope

- [x] CHK001 Requirements preserve the existing Package 2 retrieval by default and name the exact red-test condition for any production change. [Spec FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 Requirements cover every Package 4 exit condition without adding Package 5, WebMCP, UI, hosted, deployment, or publication scope. [Spec SC-001–SC-008]
- [x] CHK003 Requirements explicitly preserve v1 bytes/invalid status and v2 sealed inputs/algorithm/thresholds. [Spec FR-002–FR-004]

## Holdout and dependency boundary

- [x] CHK004 The holdout boundary is unambiguous: hash-only byte access, with no parse/import/print/score/inspection or evaluator execution. [Spec FR-002, FR-014]
- [x] CHK005 Production-versus-benchmark dependency direction and the sole data-only corpus-seed allowance are exact and transitively testable. [Spec FR-005, FR-010]
- [x] CHK006 Fixture validation requirements cover strict manifest, schema, counts, materialization, references, neutrality, calibration consistency, and tamper failures without a new dependency. [Spec FR-002–FR-004]

## Retrieval and D1 behavior

- [x] CHK007 Development requirements cover all 12 cases, exact dispositions/goldens, forbidden records, rank vectors, ties, explanations, conflicts, abstentions, bounds, baselines, ablations, metrics, and 100-repeat bytes. [Spec FR-005–FR-006]
- [x] CHK008 D1 requirements name every eligibility exclusion and require the actual prepared production query, not a surrogate. [Spec FR-007]
- [x] CHK009 D1 acceptance includes in-memory parity, deterministic order, a hard 36-row maximum, exact-plan index evidence, and a red-test prerequisite for migration. [Spec FR-008]
- [x] CHK010 Nil, conflict, malformed-data, required-ranker, SQL, and interrupted-command failure semantics are explicit and fail closed. [Spec FR-009; Plan Engineering Lens]

## Verification and handoff

- [x] CHK011 The canonical gate includes prior regressions, build, browser, audits, Package 4 layers, source/evidence binding, review, and convergence without overstating hosted evidence. [Spec FR-011–FR-013]
- [x] CHK012 Final custody requirements bind one local checkpoint and an exact no-local clone while keeping main, pilot, holdout, external systems, and later packages untouched. [Spec SC-007–SC-008]
